name: page-detail-screens
goal: Page details show concise identity, fixed page screenshots and viewport controls without scenario/state selectors or a commit action; every tab is captured

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Page detail keeps concise identity and viewport controls; every page tab has screenshots and inherited proof retains its origin.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Standard entity preview tests checked placement but not excess copy or controls; unit coverage lacked validated inherited captures. Extend those tests across every viewport.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Frozen dc72a014 fails page header stays concise at desktop, tablet and mobile; validated inherited screenshot assertion also fails. Red record ff3c705815a17f9d3a77efc37315bda683583b212876fa9e7070fe1fcd4f4bd7.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus 5.5 removed repeated page copy and selectors. Fixed previews reach both callers; validated unchanged screenshots retain their capture origin.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
